initial-dialogue.player: I was wondering if you could repair my pouches.

initial-dialogue.npc: I need 25 abyssal pearls to unlock the contact with the mage who knows how to repair a pouch. After the contact has been unlocked, it will cost you 1 abyssal pearl each time to repair the pouches.

initial-dialogue.text: If the player does not have enough abyssal pearls in their inventory:

steps.player: I don't have enough abyssal pearls for that, I'm afraid.

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has enough abyssal pearls in their inventory:

steps.prompt: Pay 25 abyssal pearls to unlock the pouch repair?

steps.npc: Now bear with me whilst I contact the mage.

steps.text: Apprentice Cordelia casts the Astral Contact spell.

steps.speaker: Dark Mage
steps.text: Quiet! Why do you all try to break my concentration?

steps.npc: OK. The contact has been set up.
It will cost you 1 abyssal pearl to repair the pouches.

subsequent-dialogue.player: I was wondering if you could repair my pouches.

subsequent-dialogue.npc: It will cost you 1 abyssal pearl to repair the pouches.

subsequent-dialogue.text: If the player does not have an abyssal pearl in their inventory:

steps.player: I don't have enough abyssal pearls for that, I'm afraid.

subsequent-dialogue.text: If the player has an abyssal pearl in their inventory:

steps.text: If the player does not have a degraded essence pouch:

steps.npc: You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair.

steps.text: If the player has a degraded essence pouch:

steps.npc: Bear with me whilst I make the contact for repairing the pouches.

steps.text: Apprentice Cordelia casts the Astral Contact spell.

steps.npc: Hello, I know you can hear me.
Ding Dong, Ding Dong. You can't keep me waiting.
I got someone here in need of a pouch repair.

overhead-dialogue.npc: We need to assemble rift guardian before those creatures arrive!
We need shield barriers up before anything comes through that rift!
We need to protect the Great Guardian!
We need to power up the Great Guardian!
